title: 極速靜態路由
content:
This example demonstrates the absolute minimal footprint of Photon. By defining a route without middleware or dynamic parameters, Photon engages its MinimalContext optimization automatically.

Optimal Implementation

import { Gravito } from '@gravito/core/engine'

const app = new Gravito()

// Pure static route uses MinimalContext for O(1) dispatch
app.get('/ping', (c) => {
  return c.text('pong')
})

export default {
  fetch: app.fetch.bind(app)
}

Lab Note: The engine's Static Analyzer detects that this handler only uses c.text() and bypasses the expensive context pooling logic entirely.
